# Getting Help

Thanks for using Tiao! Here's how to get help:

## Documentation

- **[Game Rules](../docs/GAME_RULES.md)** — how to play
- **[Architecture](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)** — system design and technical overview
- **[API Reference](../docs/API.md)** — REST and WebSocket API
- **[Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md)** — how to set up and contribute
- **[Testing Guide](../docs/TESTING.md)** — running and writing tests

## Questions and Discussions

For questions, ideas, and general discussion, use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/trebeljahr/tiao/discussions).

## Bug Reports and Feature Requests

Found a bug or have a feature idea? [Open an issue](https://github.com/trebeljahr/tiao/issues/new/choose) using the appropriate template.

## Security Issues

Please report security vulnerabilities privately. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for details.
